entities.summary: Piotr Semenenko, CR was a Polish Catholic priest who cofounded the Resurrectionists and served as superior general. As a philosopher and theologian, he was regarded as one of the most scholarly Polish Catholics in the second half of the 19th century. He was the author of many philosophical and theological works, as well as on the interior life. He left a massive correspondence, as well as a personal diary.
